name: # End-to-end test CSV — exercises every rule type and optional column.

#   3. Set operation in input_pipeline_trigger.yaml:  operation: add   regex: true   testing-required: true
#      (add the matching regex test under `tests:` — sample provided at the bottom of this file as a comment)
# All source paths use the `/e2e-test/...` prefix so they should not collide
# with any live rule in match-rules.tf. Names are prefixed `E2E:` so they are
# easy to spot in the generated HCL and easy to delete later.

# ── 6. Complex rule — MULTI-MATCH (protocol = https AND path) ───────────────
# ── 7. Complex rule — MULTI-MATCH (method via object_match_value AND path) ──
# Demonstrates object_match_value column with the `simple:V1|V2` form.
# The Akamai schema requires object_match_value for `method` (and a few others).
# clientip rules use a FLAT match_value with space-separated IPs/CIDRs.
# This is the working form per live deploys; object_match_value is NOT accepted
# by the Cloudlets v3 API for clientip.
